guardrails: section_eid values such as dbsect_18 are only meaningful within a debate; never join them globally.
The candidate Bill-to-section key is (debate_id, bill_debate.debate_section_id) -> (debate_id, debate_section.section_eid).
Exact heading matching is validation evidence, not the primary key when the composite source key is present.
Bill debate debate_id/debate_uri remains whole-debate grain and must never label every speech in the sitting.
Sponsor-to-member links should use sponsor_uri/member_uri, not names.
Division-to-Bill links are safe only through a certified Bill section relationship.
